title: Generating Watermarked Adversarial Texts
motivation: Adversarial text examples can be maliciously or illegally used, requiring protection mechanisms
problem_framing: Joint optimization of watermarking and adversarial text generation as a unified task
key_insight: Construct substitution sets where each word can simultaneously serve adversarial perturbation and watermark embedding
method_signature: Word-level adversarial generation with partition-based substitution sets for joint watermarking
evaluation_criteria: Attack success rate, modification rate, grammaticality, fluency (PPL), watermark extraction accuracy
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: Watermarked adversarial texts show lower attack success rates compared to non-watermarked versions; performance degrades as payload size increases
evidence_for_taste: watermarking adversarial texts is an important yet very challenging task
